core.title: Polished Chrome ADA Compliant Full Cover Grade 1 Tri Packed Door Closer, TC611-US26

text.description_html:
Full Cover Polished Chrome Door Closer

The Global TC611-US26 Polished Chrome Door Closer are recommended for use on commercial, architectural and institutional applications where a shinny chrome closer is required. ADA compliant they are ideal for business, new construction and renovations.

Global Series TC611-US26 door closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and adjustable backcheck cushioning. Available with optional parallel mounting bracket. They fit 11 3/32" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

The TC611-US26 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 4 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

Features of Global TC611-US26 Chrome Door Closer:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11 3/32"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 44" interior / 36" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 243 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1-4
  • Non Handed
  • ADA Compliant
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Includes Full Plastic Cover
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 15 Year Warranty

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.



*This item is Discontinued. Use PDQ-5501-BCPA-625 Polished Chrome Door Closer
